reporting-org.narrative: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade

description.narrative: To ensure that the livelihoods of Pacific farmers and exporters involved in exporting fresh produce is sustained. It will partner with MPI and Pacific National Plant Protection Organisations to implement robust export assurance systems that meet importing countries’ biosecurity requirements. These systems will help to maintain existing exports and prevent pathway suspensions from occurring. NB: Activity set up to separate it from the Enhanced Pacific Biosecurity Programme (Act-0101343).
